question: Which of the following Bollywood actresses was honoured at the inaugural Global Vanguard Honour, 2025, held in Los Angeles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Priyanka Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Priyanka Chopra** is a globally recognized Indian actress, producer, and philanthropist known for her significant contributions to cinema and humanitarian work.
 
• In **2025**, Priyanka Chopra was honoured at the **inaugural Global Vanguard Honour** held in **Los Angeles**, acknowledging her influence and achievements in promoting diversity and global representation.
 
• The **Global Vanguard Honour** celebrates individuals who have made groundbreaking contributions to their respective fields, and Priyanka Chopra's work in Bollywood, Hollywood, and her activism for gender equality earned her this prestigious recognition.
 
• Priyanka Chopra has also been a recipient of various international awards, including her recognition as a **UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador**, showcasing her commitment to social causes.
 
• Her career spans both Indian and international platforms, making her one of the most influential celebrities representing India on a global scale.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Priyanka Chopra:**

 
 
• Born on **18 July 1982**, Priyanka Chopra is an acclaimed Indian actress and former **Miss World (2000).**
 
• She has acted in numerous Bollywood films, including **Bajirao Mastani**, **Barfi**, and **Mary Kom**, earning critical and commercial success.
 
• She gained international fame with her role in the American TV series **Quantico** and appeared in Hollywood films like **Baywatch** and **Isn't It Romantic**.
 
• Priyanka Chopra is actively involved in humanitarian work and has supported causes such as **education for girls**, **gender equality**, and **child welfare** through her foundation, the **Purple Pebble Pictures**.
 
 
 
• **Global Vanguard Honour:**
 
 
• This prestigious award recognizes individuals who have significantly contributed to their respective fields on a global level.
 
• It emphasizes the importance of diversity, inclusion, and representation in various industries.
 
• Being the inaugural event, the **2025 Global Vanguard Honour** marked a milestone in recognizing global achievements across cultures and professions.
 
• The event was held in **Los Angeles**, a city widely regarded as the epicenter of entertainment and global culture.
 
 
 
• **Bollywood Actresses (Other Options):**
 
 
• **Nitanshi Goel:** A young Indian actress known for her work in television but not a recipient of any global awards like Priyanka Chopra.
 
• **Deepika Padukone:** Another renowned Bollywood actress known for her performances and advocacy for mental health awareness but not associated with the 2025 Global Vanguard Honour.
 
• **Pratibha Ranta:** A lesser-known actress in Bollywood primarily associated with television shows and regional cinema.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Priyanka Chopra's Global Impact:**

 
 
• She is one of the few Indian actresses to transition successfully from Bollywood to Hollywood, breaking barriers for South Asian representation.
 
• Priyanka Chopra's philanthropic efforts include her association with **UNICEF**, advocating for child rights, and being a staunch supporter of **gender equality**.
 
 
 
• **Recognition of Indian Talent Globally:**
 
 
• The honour reflects the growing influence of Indian artists on global platforms and highlights India's contribution to arts and culture.
 
• Award ceremonies like the **Global Vanguard Honour** aim to celebrate diversity and inclusion, encouraging cross-cultural collaborations.
